sloka: सुग्रीवस्तु ततः प्राह रामम् सत्यपराक्रमम् ।हनुमन्तम् त्वमारोह अङ्गदम् त्वथ लक्ष्मणः ॥६-२२-८०॥।।
transliteration: sugrīvastu tataḥ prāha rāmam satyaparākramam ।hanumantam tvamāroha aṅgadam tvatha lakṣmaṇaḥ ॥6-22-80॥।।

translations.english: Sugriva addressed Rama of truthful valour and said, "You mount on heroic Hanuman, let Lakshmana climb on Angada. These Vanaras will hold you up in the sky and assist you to cross the ocean."
